title: Display and on-screen information
summary: Feedback in this topic centers on what the vehicle screen shows, spanning appreciated camera views and displayable trip information alongside several unclear mentions of texts, connection status, and missing data display.

positive.summary: Positive comments praise reversing camera street-view imagery and the ability or desire to view trip information such as consumption, elapsed time, and distance on the standard display.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined comments mention inconsistent text-message display, connected status, missing data visibility, USB media info not appearing on screen, and a redirected message request without enough context to classify sentiment.

limitations: Most sampled fragments are undetermined, so sentiment is unclear for several display and messaging mentions.
The topic mixes several loosely related subjects, including camera views, trip-information display, phone or text-message behavior, connection status, and USB media info.
Examples are brief and sometimes lack enough context to tell whether the reviewer is praising a feature, reporting a fault, or describing a setup issue.
